components.text: The design fee counts as RMB 8,000. It was withheld at 20%, and at year end it falls in the 10% bracket

footnote: Source: STA Announcement No. 61 of 2018, Art. 8 and withholding rate table 2
notes: Where does the 800 come from? Take salary alone: taxable income would be 180,000 minus 128,400, which is 51,600, and the tax 51,600 times 10% minus 2,520, which is 2,640. Exactly what the employer withheld. So salary breaks even. The whole refund comes from the design fee. When it was paid, 20% was taken off as expenses, leaving 8,000, and 20% of that was withheld: 1,600. Pooled with the year, this person's top rate is only 10%, so those 8,000 should bear 800. The extra 800 comes back. The 20% on freelance pay is a withholding rate, not the tax rate. At year end it is recalculated at your own rate.
